name: Conjure
description: Build Claude Code skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from plain-language descriptions. Generate, validate, and ship plugins without writing boilerplate.
longDescription:
Ships **7 commands**.

- **Commands** (7): `conjure-agent` (Creates or updates a Claude Code agent definition (~/.claude/agents/<name>.md or project-local)), `conjure-config` (Set, view, or remove conjure preferences), `conjure-help` (Show help for the conjure toolkit — all commands, argument syntax, update modes, and decision guide), `conjure-hook` (Create or update a Claude Code hook (settings.json entry + shell script)), `conjure-mcp` (Create a Claude Code MCP (Model Context Protocol) server), `conjure-skill` (Create or update a Claude Code skill (.md command file) with best practices), `conjure` (Use when you want to build a new Claude Code skill, agent, hook, or MCP server but aren't…)

Installs with `claude plugin install conjure@claude-community` from `john-farina/claude-plugins` (`plugins/conjure`).
